exposure_formula.name: governor_exposure_usd
exposure_formula.cash_spend_counted_usd: Irreversible Month-1 provider cash charges/purchases, including the full face value of prepaid funding purchased in Month 1.
exposure_formula.unpaid_committed_usd: Conservative cost already contractually/operationally committed but not yet included in cash_spend_counted_usd.
exposure_formula.admitted_queued_unfunded_usd: Conservative maximum incremental cost of admitted/queued paid work not already represented in cash or commitments, reduced only by remaining prepaid credit whose original purchase is already counted in cash_spend_counted_usd.
exposure_formula.prepaid_rule: Count a prepaid funding purchase in full at purchase time. Usage consuming that already-counted credit does not add exposure a second time. If admitted/queued work exceeds remaining already-counted prepaid credit, only the excess is added as admitted_queued_unfunded_usd. Refunds reduce cash_spend_counted_usd only after provider-confirmed settlement evidence exists.
exposure_formula.reporting_lag_rule: Admission uses HONOR reservations before dispatch; provider usage/invoice lag can never reduce or postpone the reservation. Reconciliation replaces estimates without releasing exposure below known irreversible cash/commitments.
calculation_order: 1. Sum irreversible Month-1 cash charges/purchases into cash_spend_counted_usd, including full face value of prepaid funding at purchase time.
2. Sum unavoidable but not-yet-cash obligations into unpaid_committed_usd, excluding anything already counted as cash.
3. Reserve every admitted/queued paid job before dispatch at a conservative maximum incremental cost.
4. Offset queued reservations only by remaining prepaid credit whose original purchase is already present in cash_spend_counted_usd; put only the excess into admitted_queued_unfunded_usd.
5. governor_exposure_usd = cash_spend_counted_usd + unpaid_committed_usd + admitted_queued_unfunded_usd. Use exact Decimal arithmetic; never binary floating point for admission.
6. Evaluate the post-admission exposure before any paid job/call/purchase is dispatched.
exposure_formula.admission_rule: A proposed paid action is classified CORE_REQUIRED, OPTIONAL, or EMERGENCY_ALLOWED. OPTIONAL is admitted only when both current and post-admission exposure are <43.000000. CORE_REQUIRED is admitted only when post-admission exposure is <51.030000. EMERGENCY_ALLOWED is admitted in RESERVE only when its purpose is recovery/security/reconciliation and post-admission exposure is <56.030000. At exposure >=56.030000 no paid action is admitted.
exposure_formula.prepaid_purchase_cap_rule: Purchasing prepaid credit itself is a paid purchase and must pass the same post-admission governor test. The full purchase face value is counted immediately in cash_spend_counted_usd. Consuming already-counted credit later changes economic usage records but does not add governor cash exposure again.
exposure_formula.provider_reporting_lag: HONOR reservations are authoritative for admission until reconciled. Missing/delayed provider usage cannot lower exposure. Reconciliation may replace an estimate with actual evidence but cannot remove irreversible cash or unavoidable commitments.

admission_examples.optional_at_42_99_cost_0_005: ADMIT only if post-admission exposure remains <43.000000
